title: fix(ui): word-majority bidi direction, not first-strong-char
context:
dir="auto" alone still misjudged mixed Hebrew/Latin paragraphs: the
Unicode bidi algorithm picks direction from the FIRST strong-directional
character only, so a Hebrew sentence that opens with (or is dominated by
character count of) an English term/acronym like "App Password" or
"Google" rendered fully left-aligned/LTR even though it reads as Hebrew.

tagBlocksForRtl() now counts which script each whitespace-delimited word
belongs to and sets dir="rtl"/"ltr" explicitly by majority vote across
w
